patterns.note: Content is organized into full-width sections, often with a main heading and introductory text, followed by card-based grids for showcasing destinations, activities, or articles.
A warm, light beige (#FDF4E0) is used consistently for section backgrounds and the footer, providing a soft contrast to the dominant white content areas and natural imagery.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content to create a sense of depth as the user scrolls down the page.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay with light text in the hero section to a sticky bar with a solid white background and dark text once scrolled past the hero.
Interactive accordion elements are used for FAQ sections, allowing users to expand and collapse answers without navigating away.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, immersive background image that moves at a slower rate than the page content during scroll, creating a parallax depth effect. The main navigation bar is initially transparent and positioned over the hero, then transitions to a fixed position at the top of the viewport with a solid background and contrasting text color after the user scrolls past the hero section. Content sections below the hero appear as the user scrolls, with subtle reveal animations likely driven by css-keyframes, though no dramatic fade-ins or slide-ups are strongly evident beyond standard scroll behavior.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide clear hierarchy, with body text at a comfortable reading size and smaller, often uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., ~4-8px) are applied to cards, buttons, and input fields, creating a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing is used throughout, with generous vertical padding between sections and consistent internal padding within card components, contributing to a clean and uncluttered layout.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-quality, immersive natural photography as hero imagery, combined with a warm, inviting beige accent color, creates an aspirational and welcoming feel that elevates it beyond a typical tourism site. The subtle parallax effect on the hero further enhances this immersive experience.
